vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look, friends! A little green pod is hanging from the branch.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's wiggling... wiggle, wiggle! Something is inside!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What could be hiding in there? Can you guess?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Crack! It's opening!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Ta-da! It's me! I'm Bella the butterfly!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: My wings are all wet and crumpled. Let me dry them in the sun.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bella opens her wings, slowly, slowly... Wow! So many colours!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Bella! I'm Bobo! Your wings are so pretty!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What sound does a butterfly make?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Shhh! Listen...

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Butterflies are very, very quiet. We just go flutter, flutter!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you flutter like Bella? Flap your arms, softly. Flutter, flutter!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Here are three amazing butterfly facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number one. Every butterfly starts as a tiny caterpillar!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: I was a tiny egg on a leaf. Then I was a hungry caterpillar! Munch, munch, munch!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Then I made a cosy chrysalis, and I slept and changed inside.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number two. Butterflies taste with their feet!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: I land on a flower, and my feet say... mmm! Sweet!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Number three. Butterflies drink with a long, curly tongue, like a straw!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: I uncurl it, and sip, sip, sip the sweet flower juice. It's called nectar!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you sip like a butterfly? Sip, sip, sip!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now Bella wants to go on a big journey.

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: I want to fly to the Rainbow Garden! It has the most flowers in the whole world!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But the Rainbow Garden is far away. Over the meadow, past the pond, and up the hill.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: We'll come with you, Bella!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Yes! It's an adventure!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Off they go! Bella flutters, and her friends walk along.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh no! Here comes a big wind! Whoooosh!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Help! The wind is pushing me!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Bella! Hold on to the flower!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bella holds on tight, and waits... and waits...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The wind stops. Phew!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: I'm OK! When the wind is big, I hold on and wait.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now they walk past the pond. But look at the sky!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Big grey clouds! Pitter, patter... it's raining!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Oh no! Butterflies can't fly in the rain! Wet wings are too heavy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What can Bella do? How can she stay dry? Hmm...

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I know! Fly super fast, between the raindrops!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Leo! Nobody can fly between the raindrops!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oops! Silly me!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: I have an idea! A big leaf, like an umbrella!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bobo holds a big green leaf, and everybody hides underneath.

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Thank you, Bobo! I'm nice and dry!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The rain stops, the sun comes out, and look...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A rainbow! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bella flies up the hill. She is getting tired.

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: My wings are so tired. I need a little rest.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bella lands... right on Bobo's nose!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hee hee! It tickles! Ah... ah... ACHOO!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Wheee! Hee hee! That's OK, Bobo. Now I'm ready to go!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Little by little, flutter by flutter, Bella keeps going.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And then... they reach the top of the hill.

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: The Rainbow Garden! I made it!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look at all the flowers! Let's count the colours with Bella!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One, red! Two, yellow! Three, purple!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And look who lives here. Lots of butterfly friends!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Hello, everybody! I flew all the way here!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A big journey is done little by little. When it's hard, rest, and keep going!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What is something YOU learned to do, little by little?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember! Are you ready?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What was Bella before she was a butterfly?

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: A hungry caterpillar! Munch, munch!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What do butterflies taste with?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Their feet!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What did Bella do when the big wind came?

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: I held on, and waited!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can butterflies fly between the raindrops?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: No! Silly me! We used a big leaf!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where did Bella rest when she was tired?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: On my nose! Achoo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Flutter!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Rest!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Keep going!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Flutter! Rest! Keep going!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Bye bye, friends! Flutter, flutter!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
